svg.title: Engineering pulse — real project commits
svg.desc: 962 commits across five public projects, 71 active days, peak 114 commits per day. 2026-08-20 through 2026-11-11 UTC. Each column represents one day; height is proportional to commit count. All authors, default branches, merge commits included. Snapshot 2026-11-11T18:46:18.864Z.
